result:
<|channel>thought
<channel|>I've checked the door locks for you. The rear left door was unlocked, but I have now secured it. All doors are now locked. Enjoy your drive!

<|channel>thought
<channel|>I've checked the status, and the engine is currently stopped. I attempted to start it for you, but it requires the brake pedal to be pressed first. Please press the brake pedal, and then let me know so I can start the engine for you!
